segments.he: מֶלֶךְ מִסְתַּפֵּר בְּכׇל יוֹם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״מֶלֶךְ בְּיׇפְיוֹ תֶּחֱזֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ״. כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מֵעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת, אָמַר רַב שְׁמוּאֵל בַּר נַחְמָן אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: הוֹאִיל וּמִשְׁמָרוֹת מִתְחַדְּשׁוֹת.
segments.en: The Gemara explains: «A king has his hair cut every day, as it is stated: “Your eyes should see the king in his beauty”» (Isaiah 33:17), so his beauty must be tended to daily. «A High Priest» waits «from the eve of Shabbat» to the eve of Shabbat, as «Rav Shmuel bar Naḥman says» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan says: Since new» priestly «watches begin» every week on the eve of Shabbat, the High Priest must have his hair cut in order to look his best when the new watch arrives.
